Presidential Documents
2577 Federal Register / Vol. 90, No. 7 / Monday, January 13, 2025 / Presidential Documents 
Executive Order 14134 of January 3, 2025 
Providing an Order of Succession Within the Department of 
Agriculture 
By the authority vested in me as President by the Constitution and the 
laws of the United States of America, including the Federal Vacancies Reform 
Act of 1998, as amended, 5 U.S.C. 3345 et seq. (the ‘‘Act’’), it is hereby 
ordered that:

clauses.label: Section 1.
clauses.text:
Section 1. Order of Succession. (a) Subject to the provisions of section 
2 of this order, and to the limitations set forth in the Act, the following 
officials of the Department of Agriculture, in the order listed, shall act 
as and perform the functions and duties of the office of Secretary of Agri-
culture (Secretary) during any period in which both the Secretary and the 
Deputy Secretary of Agriculture have died, resigned, or otherwise become 
unable to perform the functions and duties of the office of Secretary:

clauses.label: (i)
clauses.text: (i) Under Secretary of Agriculture for Farm Production and Conservation;

clauses.label: (ii)
clauses.text:
(ii) Under Secretary of Agriculture for Food, Nutrition, and Consumer 
Services;

clauses.label: (iii)
clauses.text: (iii) Under Secretary of Agriculture for Natural Resources and Environment;

clauses.label: (iv)
clauses.text: (iv) Under Secretary of Agriculture for Research, Education, and Economics;

clauses.label: (v)
clauses.text: (v) Under Secretary of Agriculture for Rural Development;

clauses.label: (vi)
clauses.text: (vi) Under Secretary of Agriculture for Food Safety;

clauses.label: (vii)
clauses.text: (vii) Under Secretary of Agriculture for Marketing and Regulatory Programs;

clauses.label: (viii)
clauses.text:
(viii) Under Secretary of Agriculture for Trade and Foreign Agricultural 
Affairs;

clauses.label: (ix)
clauses.text: (ix) General Counsel of the Department of Agriculture;

clauses.label: (x)
clauses.text:
(x) Assistant Secretary of Agriculture (Congressional Relations and Intergov-
ernmental Affairs);

clauses.label: (xi)
clauses.text: (xi) Chief Financial Officer, Department of Agriculture;

clauses.label: (xii)
clauses.text: (xii) Assistant Secretary of Agriculture (Civil Rights);

clauses.label: (xiii)
clauses.text: (xiii) Assistant Secretary of Agriculture (Administration);

clauses.label: (xiv)
clauses.text: (xiv) Chief of Staff, Office of the Secretary;

clauses.label: (xv)
(xvi)
clauses.text: (xvi) Director, Office of Budget and Program Analysis; and

clauses.label: (xvii)
clauses.text: (xvii) Chief, United States Forest Service.

clauses.label: (b)
clauses.text:
(b) If any two or more individuals designated in subsection (a)(xv) of 
this section were sworn in to, or commenced service in, their respective 
offices on the same day, precedence shall be determined by the alphabetical 
order of the State in which the individual serves.

clauses.label: Sec. 2.
clauses.text:
Sec. 2. Exceptions. (a) No individual who is serving in an office listed 
in section 1(a)(i)–(xvii) of this order in an acting capacity shall, by virtue 
of so serving, act as Secretary pursuant to this order. 
VerDate Sep<11>2014 16:07 Jan 10, 2025 Jkt 265001 PO 00000 Frm 00001 Fmt 4790 Sfmt 4790 E:\FR\FM\13JAE0.SGM 13JAE0ddrumheller on DSK120RN23PROD with PRESDOC-E0
=== PDF page 2 of 2 ===
2578 Federal Register / Vol. 90, No. 7 / Monday, January 13, 2025 / Presidential Documents

clauses.label: (b)
clauses.text: (b) No individual who is serving in an office listed in section 1(a)(i)–

clauses.label: (xvii)
clauses.text:
(xvii) of this order shall act as Secretary unless that individual is otherwise 
eligible to so serve under the Act.

clauses.label: (c)
clauses.text:
(c) Notwithstanding the provisions of this order, the President retains 
discretion, to the extent permitted by law, to depart from this order in 
designating an acting Secretary.

clauses.label: Sec. 3.
clauses.text:
Sec. 3. Revocation. Executive Order 13612 of May 21, 2012 (Providing an 
Order of Succession Within the Department of Agriculture), is hereby re-
voked.

clauses.label: Sec. 4.
clauses.text:
Sec. 4. General Provisions. (a) Nothing in this order shall be construed 
to impair or otherwise affect:

clauses.label: (i)
clauses.text:
(i) the authority granted by law to an executive department or agency, 
or the head thereof; or

clauses.label: (ii)
clauses.text:
(ii) the functions of the Director of the Office of Management and Budget 
relating to budgetary, administrative, or legislative proposals.

clauses.label: (b)
clauses.text:
(b) This order shall be implemented consistent with applicable law and 
subject to the availability of appropriations.

clauses.label: (c)
clauses.text:
(c) This order is not intended to, and does not, create any right or benefit, 
substantive or procedural, enforceable at law or in equity by any party 
against the United States, its departments, agencies, or entities, its officers, 
employees, or agents, or any other person.

2577 Federal Register / Vol. 90, No. 7 / Monday, January 13, 2025 / Presidential Documents 
Executive Order 14134 of January 3, 2025 
Providing an Order of Succession Within the Department of 
Agriculture 
By the authority vested in me as President by the Constitution and the 
laws of the United States of America, including the Federal Vacancies Reform 
Act of 1998, as amended, 5 U.S.C. 3345 et seq. (the ‘‘Act’’), it is hereby 
ordered that: 
Section 1. Order of Succession. (a) Subject to the provisions of section 
2 of this order, and to the limitations set forth in the Act, the following 
officials of the Department of Agriculture, in the order listed, shall act 
as and perform the functions and duties of the office of Secretary of Agri-
culture (Secretary) during any period in which both the Secretary and the 
Deputy Secretary of Agriculture have died, resigned, or otherwise become 
unable to perform the functions and duties of the office of Secretary: 
(i) Under Secretary of Agriculture for Farm Production and Conservation; 
(ii) Under Secretary of Agriculture for Food, Nutrition, and Consumer 
Services; 
(iii) Under Secretary of Agriculture for Natural Resources and Environment; 
(iv) Under Secretary of Agriculture for Research, Education, and Economics; 
(v) Under Secretary of Agriculture for Rural Development; 
(vi) Under Secretary of Agriculture for Food Safety; 
(vii) Under Secretary of Agriculture for Marketing and Regulatory Programs; 
(viii) Under Secretary of Agriculture for Trade and Foreign Agricultural 
Affairs; 
(ix) General Counsel of the Department of Agriculture; 
(x) Assistant Secretary of Agriculture (Congressional Relations and Intergov-
ernmental Affairs); 
(xi) Chief Financial Officer, Department of Agriculture; 
(xii) Assistant Secretary of Agriculture (Civil Rights); 
(xiii) Assistant Secretary of Agriculture (Administration); 
(xiv) Chief of Staff, Office of the Secretary; 
(xv) State Executive Directors of the Farm Service Agency for the States 
of Kansas, Missouri, and Iowa, in order of seniority fixed by length of 
unbroken service as State Executive Director of that State; 
(xvi) Director, Office of Budget and Program Analysis; and 
(xvii) Chief, United States Forest Service. 
(b) If any two or more individuals designated in subsection (a)(xv) of 
this section were sworn in to, or commenced service in, their respective 
offices on the same day, precedence shall be determined by the alphabetical 
order of the State in which the individual serves. 
Sec. 2. Exceptions. (a) No individual who is serving in an office listed 
in section 1(a)(i)–(xvii) of this order in an acting capacity shall, by virtue 
of so serving, act as Secretary pursuant to this order.
